The third alpha of the **IdeaBlade Validation Editor**, a desktop editor for [IdeaBlade Validation](https://github.com/Breeze/ideablade-validation)'s validation metadata. It keeps itself up to date from now on, makes long lists searchable, and warns about rules that don't fit the property they're on.

> **Note:** What you see here was written in a few hours with the help of [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code). It's meant as a developer tool, not a fully fleshed-out production app.

## Downloads

| | Download | Installing |
|---|---|---|
| **Windows** (x64) | [IdeaBlade-Validation-Editor-Setup-0.1.0-alpha.3.exe](https://github.com/Breeze/ideablade-validation-editor/releases/download/v0.1.0-alpha.3/IdeaBlade-Validation-Editor-Setup-0.1.0-alpha.3.exe) | Run it. It's not code-signed, so SmartScreen may warn: *More info* → *Run anyway*. It installs for everyone (Program Files, with an administrator prompt) or only for you, over an earlier alpha if that's installed. |
| **macOS**, Apple silicon | [IdeaBlade-Validation-Editor-0.1.0-alpha.3-mac-arm64.dmg](https://github.com/Breeze/ideablade-validation-editor/releases/download/v0.1.0-alpha.3/IdeaBlade-Validation-Editor-0.1.0-alpha.3-mac-arm64.dmg) | Open it and drag the app to Applications. It's not signed with an Apple certificate or notarized, so the first time, right-click the app → *Open* → *Open* (or run `xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine "/Applications/IdeaBlade Validation Editor.app"`). |
| **macOS**, Intel | [IdeaBlade-Validation-Editor-0.1.0-alpha.3-mac-x64.dmg](https://github.com/Breeze/ideablade-validation-editor/releases/download/v0.1.0-alpha.3/IdeaBlade-Validation-Editor-0.1.0-alpha.3-mac-x64.dmg) | As for Apple silicon. |
| **Linux** (x64) | [IdeaBlade-Validation-Editor-0.1.0-alpha.3-linux-x86_64.AppImage](https://github.com/Breeze/ideablade-validation-editor/releases/download/v0.1.0-alpha.3/IdeaBlade-Validation-Editor-0.1.0-alpha.3-linux-x86_64.AppImage) | `chmod +x` it and run it. |
| **Linux**, Debian or Ubuntu (x64) | [IdeaBlade-Validation-Editor-0.1.0-alpha.3-linux-amd64.deb](https://github.com/Breeze/ideablade-validation-editor/releases/download/v0.1.0-alpha.3/IdeaBlade-Validation-Editor-0.1.0-alpha.3-linux-amd64.deb) | `sudo apt install ./IdeaBlade-Validation-Editor-0.1.0-alpha.3-linux-amd64.deb` |

The Windows installer was checked on Windows 11. The macOS and Linux builds come from GitHub's runners and haven't been tried on those systems yet: please open an issue if they don't start.

**Coming from alpha.1 or alpha.2:** install this one over it once, by hand. From this version on, the editor updates itself.

## What's new since alpha.2

- **Automatic updates.** On Windows and with the Linux AppImage, the editor checks for a new version at start and every few hours, downloads it in the background, and offers **Restart to update** in the status bar (it asks about unsaved changes first); otherwise the update is installed when you quit. On macOS and with the .deb, which can't update themselves, it says when a new version is out and links to it. Settings: **Check for updates automatically** and **Include pre-releases**, both on. A new **Help** menu has Check for Updates…, Releases on GitHub and About.
- **Searchable lists.** The fields that offer names (a new model type, `extends`, `from`, a new property, a validator, compare's `other`, Try it's model type, the regular expression panel's common patterns) narrow as you type: any part of a name, or several parts (`cust name` finds `Customer.name`), with the matches marked; ▾ shows the whole list. A model-level rule's property names are chips with ✕ and a field to add one.
- **Rules that don't fit.** A warning when a validator is meant for another kind of value than the property holds (`pattern` or `maxLength` on a true/false, `date` on text without `allowString`), for the library's validators and, read from their code, the application's own; the validator lists mark them with ⚠. `from` lists every property with its type, warns when it points at another kind of value, and explains a bare type that has no property of the same name.
- **Issues take you to the place.** Clicking an issue in the Issues tab opens the property and rule it's in and highlights its message under the field, so you can fix it there.
- **Smaller things.** The selected model type is scrolled into view when a project opens; JSON files with Windows line ends no longer open as unsaved (and keep their line ends when saved); "property…" says why its list is empty when no source knows the type.
- **Under the hood.** The code is reorganised: one Angular component per file, with its template and styles beside it, and the Electron main process in TypeScript, split by what it does. Nothing changes in how it works.

See the [README](https://github.com/Breeze/ideablade-validation-editor/blob/v0.1.0-alpha.3/README.md) for the details, [alpha.2's notes](https://github.com/Breeze/ideablade-validation-editor/releases/tag/v0.1.0-alpha.2) for what came before, and the [library's documentation](https://github.com/Breeze/ideablade-validation/tree/main/docs) for the metadata itself.
